programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death – a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Jarring Jerkiness of the Judge J.O.R.T.S
programme.desc: George and Harold transform their new Spanish teacher into a superhero after they feel guilty for pranking him, but their teacher loves it and gets carried away

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Strange Strife of the Smelly Socktopus
programme.desc: After Erica convinces them that being suspended is a great vacation, George and Harold pull off every prank they can think of in order to get suspended

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Birthday Blues
programme.desc: Missing his old life on his birthday, Boss tries to have a full-fledged grown-up celebration in Chicago, but Carol is the only one able to chauffeur and take care of him. The two battle at every stop of the birthday party tour, but when Boss's old work nemesis sets him up for an Federal Investigation Sting at an improv comedy show, Boss and Carol are forced to work together to escape the law.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Cowboy Next Door
programme.desc: When the annual roundup and town dance brings cowboy Javier to Miradero Lucky finds a new friend who can teach her and Spirit a new trick.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Pie P.I.
programme.desc: Mysteries collide when horse thieves strike Miradero at the same time as a pie thief strikes the church bake sale while the adults try to keep the horse thieves at bay Lucky is determined to find out who stole the pies.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Pie P.I.
programme.desc: Mysteries collide when horse thieves strike Miradero at the same time as a pie thief strikes the church bake sale while the adults try to keep the horse thieves at bay Lucky is determined to find out who stole the pies.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Super Amazing And Fun Cousin Julian
programme.desc: Luckys buttons are pushed when her seemingly perfect cousin Julian comes to visit but reveals himself to be a junior con man

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - Fauxsa Unchained
programme.desc: King Julien and Maurice infiltrate a Foosa gladiator school; Sage and Clover must face their enemies; Mort decides he must form his own army

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - I Am Fartacus
programme.desc: King Julien &amp; Maurice pose as Foosa and “fight” their way to Koto's wedding; Sage &amp; Clover are captured by Koto; Mort heads to the Mortverse

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - For Whom The Bell Gods Toll
programme.desc: King Julien accidentally blows himself up and must stand trial to be awarded a second chance; Mort battles Morticus Khan for control of the Mort army

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - It's a Wonderful LARP My Sectional Romance
programme.desc: Audrey’s obsession with fun gets her too wrapped up in the Bloogey Boys’ LARPing game. The Harvey Girls and Bloogey Boys battle over who’s the rightful owner of a cool couch.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - Cereal Tiny Danger
programme.desc: The Harvey street kids set out to solve the mystery of who stole their one of a kind cereal! Lotta fights back when Tiny is told that he’s too small to race in a bike race.

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Downshift
programme.desc: After springing a coolant leak Dozer overheats and must dip in the faroff restorative mineral baths and learn to keep his temper in check along the way

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Xee
programme.desc: The Trux meet an exotic multitool Xee who uses her resourceful ways to help Revvit ClickClack and Waldo get back home and in the process learn the value of having friends

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - The Great Stink
programme.desc: When a god awful stench pours forth from the portal, Puss and company must deal with the vomit inducing consequences

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - Dances With Dingoes
programme.desc: A laid-back, festival-loving dingo emerges from the portal and teaches the orphans to boogie, but Puss soon learns the dance instructor has secret intentions

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Old Dog, New Tricks \ Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. \ Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Accidental Hero Rich Kid Ra
programme.desc: Accidental Hero In order to win the Fright Stuff Award, Casper consults his uncles for scaring advice. Rich Kid Ra When Ra pulls up to Scare School in a solid gold chariot, everyone suddenly wants to be his best friend.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Dragon Quest Opposite Day
programme.desc: Dragon Quest The unlucky staff of a medieval-themed restaurant in Deedstown, get an unfriendly visit from Professor Thurdigree Burns. Opposite Day When Wolfie's experiment with moonlight goes awry, everyone but Casper turns into his or her opposite.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Joy!
programme.desc: The annual town dance competition is coming up, and Olivia is determined to put an end to the reigning champs’ (“The Prancer Dancers”) winning streak. With some help from Grandma, she forms her own rag-tag dance troupe, and learns a thing or two about dancing for the pure joy of it!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - The Mighty Five
programme.desc: After Olivia and Dad spend an afternoon reading superhero comic books, a toy of William’s suddenly goes missing! Could it be the evil doings of some evil super villain? To get William’s toy back, Olivia recruits her friends to form her own crimesolving, superhero team!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Meteor Mania
programme.desc: Olivia can’t wait to see an upcoming meteor shower – she even convinces Mom and Dad to let her stay up late to watch it. Olivia excitedly begins plans to make a family evening out of it, but Mom, Dad and Ian keep falling asleep! Olivia has to find new and creative ways to keep them awake so they don’t miss the show!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Talent Show
programme.desc: The big school talent show is coming up, and Olivia is looking forward to wowing the crowd with her drum playing. But moments before she’s scheduled to take the stage, her drum kit is accidentally destroyed! Olivia has to think fast, drumming on trash cans and other items in a rousing “Stomp”-like performance!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Cheese! Casper's New Friend
programme.desc: Cheese! ‐ Casper asks his uncle Stinky to fix Mantha’s ‘polaroid’ camera – they’ve got a ‘fear’ test and she wanted to take photos of frightened things for the test. As they struggle to fix the camera, Casper accidentally takes a picture of his uncle, who inexplicably disappears and finds himself locked inside the picture! What on EARTH is happening? Casper has to make things right – and as soon as possible so Mantha doesn’t fail her test. Thatch realizes what the camera is doing, steals it and

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - Sweet Dreams Typewriter From Hell
programme.desc: Sweet Dreams ‐ Thatch is up to no good. He’s SO desperate to win the grading trophy that he’s putting everyone to sleep – even the teachers! – in a sneaky plan to get great grades for himself. Casper works out that Thatch is using a charmed song to put everybody to sleep. Casper is determined to break the spell and Thatch will do everything he can to put Casper and his friends to sleep! Typewriter from Hell ‐ Casper has a paper to write for class, but with his computer broken he has to borrow an

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Gratitude
programme.desc: When Phoebe’s Gratitude Day card flies away before she can give it to Marcus, the Dews try to help her recreate it - perfectly. But they learn that you don't have to be perfect to show your gratitude for someone. When Athena finds herself a little short-handed at the Fairhaven Summer Fair, her cousin, Reed, comes to help; only to give Athena more problems to fix.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Glue Dew Believer
programme.desc: When Harper’s ceramic dragon is smashed, the Dews must find all the pieces. But when a piece ends up missing, the Dews work together to create a new piece, hoping no one will notice. Dylan goes to great lengths to invite his Dew Drop to his soccer game but, in the process, learns that sometimes believing in something is more powerful than seeing something.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Best Friends Day The White Whale
programme.desc: Pixie loves to ride the clouds, but she can't understand why Kelp doesn’t love it, too. If they don't agree on this, does that mean they're not best friends anymore? Kelp helps Ollie fulfill his dream of watching the white whale migration.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Shark and Pilot Fish Theo
programme.desc: When shark and pilot fish are separated it’s up to Kelp, Scallop, Cruz, and Waverly to help them find each other again. Scallop’s friend Theo finally comes clean on why he’s always rushing off.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Sick Day
programme.desc: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Bad Egg
programme.desc: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a snow globe shaped like the dollhouse, she notices the rooms inside are all cattywampus and in the wrong place. After a series of wacky misadventures that result in CatRat becoming a craft version of himself, Gabby figures out they need to fix the dollhouse globe to return everything back to normal.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Game Show
programme.desc: It’s Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the “butt xylophone” couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Fang-Tastic Halloween
programme.desc: After hearing spooky rumors about the new habitat resident- A BAT- Marty is determined to protect his friends from the newcomer. But when the bat helps him out of a tough situation, Marty learns it’s better to get to know someone rather than judge them on false stereotypes.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Tale of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Alex is mistaken for a Maine Coon and takes over that cat’s life in the penthouse. At first, VERY comfortable with his shmancy new life, Alex grows to miss his old life and learns that it’s lonely at the top.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Unpoppable Slumber Party Hard
programme.desc: Archibald accidentally ruins Bea’s plans by getting them both stuck in a giant unpoppable bubble. Archibald invites a friend to the Strutter’s slumber party who’s kind of a downer. As the party goes south, Archibald helps his friend try new things to make it through the night.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Maximum Override Gator's Giving
programme.desc: An overzealous librarian is after Archibald for an overdue library book. Archibald volunteers to be the host of Cousin Ashley’s beloved family holiday. But when Ashley’s favorite cousin threatens to bail, Archibald works extra hard to make this the best holiday ever.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - The Dark Side of the Moose: Chapter Two
programme.desc: Rocky and Bullwinkle encounter a young alien and set out on a mission to reunite him with his alien family but things get complicated when they accidentally lose him at an alien convention and Boris, Natasha and other eccentric billionaire Colonel Boudreaux are also after him

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - The Dark Side of the Moose: Chapter Three
programme.desc: A super-powered Rocky almost defeats Fearless Leader, but accidentally overdoes it, driving Fearless Leader to take his powers into space for the ultimate space take-over-the-world evil plan

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - He Blinded Me With Science
programme.desc: Julien teams up with Timo, the tenrec, a scientist who the King elists to automate everything in the kingdom.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Viva Mort
programme.desc: When Julien embarrasses Maurice, he tries to make up for his transgression, while Mort inadvertently joins an anti-King Julien group.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - The Gray Matter Fever Break
programme.desc: Oh and Tip discover an underground cult living in the sewers.While Tip is home with a fever, she witnesses a crime committed by her scheming neighbor, Donny.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Wrinkly Humans People Piggy Piggy
programme.desc: Tip doesn't think her grandparents will approve of Oh so he disguises himself as a humans housekeeperSharzod adopts Pig and names him “Juicy Booty.”

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayesh's wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Pinging
programme.desc: Mr. Ping is possessed by the ghost of Master Mastodon, the ancient master sworn to protect the Tianshang storm wheels. After a ghostly sewer chase, Mastodon agrees to help our team to stop Klaus and Veruca. He reveals that their next step is to go across the sea to Central America.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Ping's connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Beardfoot
programme.desc: Upset that he can't grow a beard, Grug resorts to some unorthodox hair growth methods. But when Phil's experimental hair formula makes fur grow all over Grug's body, he flees to the woods to avoid the other farm residents' attempts to shave him.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Stuck ToGuyther
programme.desc: An attempt to fix a broken vase leaves Guy and Hope stuck together with glue. Guy's ability to stay calm is tested when Phil is too busy to help, and the other farm residents also get stuck.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Hidelander
programme.desc: Terrible at hide-n-seek, Thunk asks Gran to teach him to hide. With her training, he soon becomes her partner in crime, helping her with heists and schemes.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Dann Hunt
programme.desc: Tony was right; Dann is back and she’s been spotted all around Los Angeles! The Spy Racers get back together on an unofficial mission to bring her down! Meanwhile, Ms. Nowhere, Palindrome and Roscoe run their out bounty hunter operation.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Wildcat
programme.desc: The team realizes they can’t stop Dann on their own, so they call in Ms. Nowhere for backup. While they try to come up with a game plan, Dann ambushes them! It’s a knock-down-drag-out brawl all through Los Gatos as they try to keep Dann from getting the mysterious devices she’s collecting. In their time of need, they turn to the last person they ever thought they’d ask for help: Cleve Kelso.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Oil and Water
programme.desc: Dann is using her resonator devices to set off a chain reaction, causing a massive earthquake and sending L.A. into the ocean. The Spy Racers stage a last stand at the final location Dann needs to go: an oil refinery on the Channel Islands. This is their final mission to save their city, and they can’t do it alone. So they decide to call in some old friends for backup.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 1
programme.desc: The Dragon Riders are surprised to discover who is behind recent attacks on nearby ships – and to learn exactly what the ships are.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Have Dragon Will Travel Pt 2
programme.desc: Heather joins the Dragon Riders, but it's not an easy alliance, especially when Hiccup uncovers a shocking secret about her true identity.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - The Next Big Sting
programme.desc: Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders rescue a wounded Speed Stinger and take it back to Dragon's Edge, unaware of the dangers that follow.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Flustering Mindless Woe of the Flushable Memory Wipes
programme.desc: After being made fun of for sitting in chocolate pudding, George and Harold go into hiding only to come back to find that everybody has forgotten who they are

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Soggy Salvation of the Swirling Sweatnami
programme.desc: Tired of mean Mr. Krupp, the boys go back in time to prevent him from becoming a bully, but discover that their plan has backfired when they return to the present

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Sickening Fumes of Smartsy Fartsy
programme.desc: In order to retrieve Mr. Krupp’s locked up rule book, George and Harold use an invention that ends up turning against them

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Sitting Ducks
programme.desc: Boss, Tina, JJ, Dez and Pip willfully get babysat by the Uncuddleables, planning to expose them as horrible sitters via secret, hidden cameras. But the plan is thrown for a loop when Tina's first night alone without her parents makes her fall for their sitter Mia as a "substitute mommy." Meanwhile, Nannycam uses the babysitting distraction to sneak into the Uncuddleables' secret garage hideout to gather intel with her own "B field team."

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Big Dumpling
programme.desc: The Uncuddleables have struck the Lil Dumpling baby pageant, replacing all of Baby Corp's super-cute top 5%er babies with not-cute bottom 5%ers. Boss, Tina and their field team race to caravan the 5%ers from their homes to the pageant before Nannycam deploys the nuclear option of unleashing the dangerously cute UBO on stage to salvage a Lil Dumpling win.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - The Great Medieval London Fire 1135
programme.desc: Boss Baby and Tina reject the 5%er system that says the cuter you are, the more love you deserve. Teaming up with the Uncuddleables, the team tries to take down the system from within, forming a resistance of the eight department heads of Baby Corp in the hopes of changing the way we look at Baby Love forever.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Harvest Hunt
programme.desc: Lucky takes part in a secret Miradero tradition a nighttime scavenger hunt

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: When Miradero's Christmas presents are delayed and snow isn't falling, Lucky and her friends decide it's up to them to bring the Christmas spirit to Miradero.

programme.title: 生活智多星第1867集

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第14集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 烤箱讀書會第42集
programme.desc: 為提倡親子共讀、快樂閱讀，全新打造專屬節目《烤箱讀書會》！日本國際兒童圖書評議會主席松居直先生說：「閱讀應該是一件快樂的事！」。不管大人或小孩，每個人都喜歡做有趣的事，如果能將閱­讀和有趣的事結合在一起，應該就能創造充滿趣味的閱讀經驗，在這個節目當中，將帶領小朋友動手做點心，利用烘焙時間，和他們共讀一本圖畫書，不僅分享故事，還有動聽的詩­歌，讓更多大小朋友透過電視，共同參與這個充滿樂趣又有益身心的閱讀活動。

programme.title: 寶島西米樂 守護第368集
programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第15集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉里衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.desc: 熱鬧的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母親雅芬穿過擁擠的人群，來到生意興隆、美軍也來光顧的「寶島西服店」，尋找失蹤的父親照清。照清曾在這裡當過學徒，和老闆梅樹師是師兄弟，但因故未能出師…。春燕看著梅樹與曉蘭鶼鰈情深地經營「寶島西服店」，這美好的景象讓春燕想起父親曾向自己承諾，未來若跟著師兄梅樹出師後，自己的西服店也會正式掛牌營業，並收女兒春燕當全台第一位西裝女徒弟，將西裝技藝傳承下去

programme.title: 愛的人生路第19集
programme.desc: 余樹木和老婆元美生了五個女兒，年過四十仍無子嗣，為了傳承香火，元美安排丈夫娶了二房綉蘭。綉蘭不負所望生下天助，原以為家庭從此圓滿和樂，未料元美早逝，大女兒阿雪和二媽綉蘭個性差異，經常為生活瑣事爭執，家庭失和，令天助十分痛苦。 余家這本難念的經，要怎麼轉變為幸福經，共走愛的人生路？

programme.title: 幸福的起點第6集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第34集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第163集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 行動現場第566集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
臺灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第22集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧語第741集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 伯源哥哥的祕密屋第45集
programme.desc: 面對環境的複雜化，情緒教育愈來愈重要，大愛電視台是台灣第一個將情緒教育注入兒童節目的電視台，從「當我們童在一起」到「童在一起＋」，2019則推出最新企劃「伯源哥哥的祕密屋」，希望能為孩子增能，培養他們為來解決問題的能力。 節目建造一個神秘的魔法空間，讓孩子能在這裡跟伯源哥哥傾訴煩惱與壓力，一起想出解決的辦法。並用戲劇手法，由伯源哥哥演出現代小孩煩惱的情境，讓孩子更能感同身受。多達20個情緒符號的「情緒臉譜」，則讓孩子更了解情緒，接受情緒；而「行動輪盤」則提供10種遇到問題時的可能做法，讓孩子有更多元的思考。節目裡並整理教養專家楊俐容、腦神經科學專家王秀園、陳志恆心理師等專家學者的專業建議，整體

programme.title: 蔬果生活誌第219集

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE

programme.title: 幸福的起點第7集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.desc: 讓世界看懂中醫，打破中醫的框架迷思，發揮預防重於治療的優點，讓台灣走向樂活社會。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 幸福的起點第8集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6917集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第619集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2115集
programme.desc: 大陸尋奇是台灣目前最社教節目之冠不惜巨資的大製作足跡踏遍各現代城市、窮鄉僻壤，深入各民族村落，記錄了外人難得一見的生活情況，以準確的地理、歷史定位，用現代化思維，把中華文化忠實的呈現。 漫遊在浩瀚中國的世外桃源，細賞湖光山色間的粉妝玉琢，帶您跋山涉水遊遍奇峰峻嶺，讓您看盡壯闊山河嘆為觀止。

programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活為藍本的故事，其中一事一物均充滿著1970年代的懷舊氣息。故事發生的舞台是日本靜岡縣清水市，那是一個不折不扣的美麗港都，是個交通便利、漁產豐富、又與富士山為鄰的好地方。故事圍繞著小丸子以及其家人和同學展開，有關於親情、友誼等，或是一些生活小事，但當中有笑有淚，令人回想起童年的稚氣。

programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第598集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 唱歌給你聽第167集
programme.desc: 故事講述一個在台灣北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父親不切實際地為這個家帶來債務、困擾與紛爭。時常失蹤的父親只能由任勞任怨的母親咬牙把這個家支撐下去。多年後四處飄浪的父親癌末回來找長大後的女兒，女兒為了處理父親的臨終把本已瓦解的家庭關係，再次找回分散各地家人，並在父親臨終前相互道歉、和解道別。

programme.title: 錦衣之下第54集
programme.desc: 天賦異稟的六扇門女捕快袁今夏（譚松韻飾）因為一樁案件和性情狠辣的錦衣衛陸繹（任嘉倫飾）結下樑子，本是道不同不相為謀，卻因驚天密案聯手。兩人從水火不容到情難自已，命運的糾葛就此旋轉一起。

programme.title: 霹靂朝靈闕第29集
programme.desc: 猂劫兵烽，無暇暗劫起，猂族利用地獄鳥力量，動盪苦境之後，雌伏多年的暗劫八無暇，也趁勢再出，為阻止這股邪惡勢力顛覆中原武林，湯問夢澤山座白象．香六牙，廣發天下舉鋒帖，召開擎天會，聚集西窗月、墨如鴉、不全鷹等湯問英傑，正心六崇越宗主巍翼、太叔望，以及儒道釋代表相繼響應，血漫河山俠骨烈，亙古之爭，勝敗由天抑由人？

programme.title: 肯尼NOW星球第9集
programme.desc: NOWnews重磅籃球企劃登場！超人氣Podcast節目「肯尼NOW星球」將由新竹攻城獅總經理「Kenny哥」高景炎主持，喜歡聽他「密」語如珠、用最專業的角度來分析國內籃壇大小事的球迷絕對不要錯過！

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第63集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 天子傳奇第21集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，征戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第63集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑后，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 天子傳奇第21集
programme.desc: 商朝第二十八代君－紂王，好大喜功，征戰連連，百姓為其榷稅徵租，貧乏窮困，哀聲載道，民心漸失。一日在平魔的慶功宴時，代表大商國運的鎮國龍龜猝亡，適時西現紫氣，紂王視為必是西出妖孽，足以禍國，便遣妖帥調領大軍征剿西岐。 西伯侯姬昌第二子名曰姬發，出世時天空出現異象，百姓皆稱其為未來聖主。姬昌算易知悉姬發有九九之命格危在旦夕，便挺險施行九鼎奇法，卻因妖帥與九大護衛殺入，反成九五至尊之數。大祭司見弄巧成拙，建請紂王宣召姬發上京面聖，藉機要將姬發煉製靈人，代替護國祥物，紂王為保王命，想盡辦法不擇手段，導致天怒人怨，因此種下亡國敗運的禍根。 姬發面聖路上，災劫連連，有飄渺城之困，卻因禍得福習得「渾天寶

programme.title: 阿叔第21集
programme.desc: 劇情講述王識賢飾演才氣縱橫而心高氣傲，且心中似乎隱藏著什麼大秘密的「木工修復師」，該戲探討如何藉由這項逐漸沒落的工藝修補眾人的羈絆，再創台灣傳統文化的價值，也將體現台灣小鎮濃厚的人情味。平凡寫實的小人物故事、真摯的情感，絕對令人又哭又笑！

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第1集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨齡差距的結伴青春旅行，走訪在地文化行銷台灣，世代差異的旅遊個性激盪出充滿意外性的實境自助旅行。當稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，會擦出什麼火花呢?這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！從陌生到熟悉！ 從畏懼到麻吉！讓小鮮肉成長！讓老熟肉回春！不囉唆！現在出發吧～

programme.title: 第一世家第21集
programme.desc: 以賴水泉家庭三位子女的婚姻及家族興衰史為情節重心，表現該家族如何與鄉里共存共榮，並描繪出台灣五十年來的成長過程及社會融合的軌跡。

programme.title: 警世劇場第21集

programme.title: Good morning 台灣第519集

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第161集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第162集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.title: 包青天第110集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 包青天第111集

programme.title: 華視午間新聞第6777集

programme.title: 阿叔第21集
programme.desc: 劇情講述王識賢飾演才氣縱橫而心高氣傲，且心中似乎隱藏著什麼大秘密的「木工修復師」，該戲探討如何藉由這項逐漸沒落的工藝修補眾人的羈絆，再創台灣傳統文化的價值，也將體現台灣小鎮濃厚的人情味。平凡寫實的小人物故事、真摯的情感，絕對令人又哭又笑！

programme.title: 新哆啦Ａ夢第343集
programme.desc: 全新版本的哆啦A夢變得更小巧可愛，其他角色也有些微的變化，但故事依舊充滿趣味！故事開始時，我們認識到一個運動神經不佳、考試總是拿零分、超級懶散又愛睡覺的小學生-野比大雄。有一天，一隻貓型機器人【哆啦Ａ夢】乘坐時光機從二十二世紀來到了大雄的房間。原來，這是大雄的曾孫【小世修】為了改變大雄悲慘的人生，特地將【哆啦Ａ夢】送到他身邊。

programme.title: 烏龍派出所第228集
programme.desc: 在東京的葛飾區有一個龜有公園，公園前有一個小派出所，那裡是小警察兩津勘吉和他的同事工作的地方。勘及個子不高，身材粗壯，心地善良，不畏冒險，急性子，有著廣泛的興趣和嗜好，最重要的是他有著很容易捲入各種麻煩的"執著"，這令他的上司及同事大為頭疼。

programme.title: 阿叔第22集

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第2集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨齡差距的結伴青春旅行，走訪在地文化行銷台灣，世代差異的旅遊個性激盪出充滿意外性的實境自助旅行。當稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，會擦出什麼火花呢?這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！從陌生到熟悉！ 從畏懼到麻吉！讓小鮮肉成長！讓老熟肉回春！不囉唆！現在出發吧～

programme.title: 第一世家第22集
programme.desc: 以賴水泉家庭三位子女的婚姻及家族興衰史為情節重心，表現該家族如何與鄉里共存共榮，並描繪出台灣五十年來的成長過程及社會融合的軌跡。

programme.title: 土地公傳奇第163集
programme.desc: 玉帝賜封的土地公（廖峻飾），原是民間稅官，因他是凡人不會做神，玉帝就在神界選了一個既漂亮又聰明的仙女（陳亞蘭飾）做他的妻子，好協助他。這位仙女是都海城隍爺（陸一龍飾）的三女兒。土地公土地婆下界為神，土地公有求必應，為民間百姓多做善事，藉助城隍爺身邊文判官（施羽飾）、武判官（黃仲裕飾）的神界力量。

programme.desc: 以賴水泉家庭三位子女的婚姻及家族興衰史為情節重心，表現該家族如何與鄉里共存共榮，並描繪出台灣五十年來的成長過程及社會融合的軌跡。

programme.title: 我們的島第1381集
programme.desc: 一個一小時的節目，能帶給觀眾什麼，能影響什麼？如果把它只當成一個節目，會感覺短短一小時很短暫，如果把它當成一條出路，會發現力量也可以很強大，一直以來，我們節目的理念就是尋求一種改變的可能性，只要有一個人因為看過報導而改變了，反省也好，感動也好，警惕也好，行動也好，就有可能形塑一種新的環境公民力量，也有可能讓錯誤的政策不再繼續。1998年11月1日「我們的島」節目正式播出，當年台灣的環境還處於大肆開發的年代，在經濟掛帥的氛圍中，「我們的島」為環境發出另一種聲音，至今「我們的島」仍是台灣媒體中，唯一以「環境」為報導主題的新聞性節目，也是公共電視開播以來歷史最久的新聞性節目，這十五年「我們的島」製作

programme.title: 月亮女孩第1集
programme.desc: 小希是個思想開放的年輕女大學生，在繁忙的學校課業之餘，經歷生活、戀愛、創作和夢的各種體驗。小希曾經有過墮胎的經 驗，卻假裝沒發生過繼續原本的生活，然而體內消失的一塊肉，像是某個部分的自己也跟著消失，藏在身體的記憶中。因為意外再次懷 孕，她又開始做夢，這些夢似乎在招喚她，去面對自己連結內在的渴望。當她從原本「無感」的狀態到「有感」，理解到尊重自己的身體，尋找愛自己的過程，對生命的態度也因此轉變。

programme.title: 空針第1集
programme.desc: (2019)一部醫療背景的電影。董秀貞(黃采儀飾)是一位資深的護理師，同時也是正在住院的小女孩陳庭汝(葛璦飾)的母親。收到女兒的病危通知的董秀貞，面臨能夠救女兒的藥劑庫存在短時間內只剩下一劑，而處方箋卻早已排程將這藥劑使用在另一位病童身上時，同時身兼醫職及母親這兩種身份的董秀貞，該做出什麼行動？

programme.title: 聽聽看第809集
programme.desc: 公共電視最長壽的節目之一。專門用手語介紹有關身心障礙議題的節目，由兩位聽障主持人以不同的層面和角度，介紹身心障礙朋友溫馨感人的故事。

programme.title: 勇鼠闖天堂第1集
programme.desc: 老鼠薇琪為了證明自己夠勇敢，於是嘗試跑去拔狐狸的毛，沒想到意外讓兩個天生的宿敵-老鼠薇琪和狐狸白肚肚，發生了不幸事故。他們在動物天堂相遇，竟為了完成這趟旅程而暫時摒棄了生前的天性，更意外成為了最好的朋友。他們一起經歷了許多意想不到的冒險，究竟他們能否克服既有的天性，與對方繼續當朋友呢？

programme.title: 帶媽媽出去玩第1集
programme.desc: (2019)夏昌明（陳以文飾）為了照顧八旬失智又失能的老母（劉引商飾），被迫失業在家，親伺起居。一家四口，長年都靠擔任保險業務員的妻子小玲（今子嫣飾）扶養。在老婆抱怨、經濟負荷、長期照護，以及身心綑綁……等多重壓力下，昌明始終抑鬱難伸。終於，在警察帶回媽媽、在太太帶走兒子、在接到一通電話後，昌明用紅筆圈起了夏季的尾巴。他決定帶媽媽出去玩……

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎麼那麼可愛第4集
programme.desc: 小鷗（奚伊鷗）是蘇家最小的媳婦，不幸在進門前後，公公跟老公就相繼掛掉，使她完全不得夫家人心。守寡的小鷗也巴不得不再跟婆家有任何牽連，但天不從人願，命運使她跟婆婆越走越近。一天婆婆邀她回去吃中秋飯，她以為婆婆好意，沒想到是要她簽字放棄丈夫的壽險繼承，而由買保險的婆婆受益。她氣得要劃清界線，結果意外發現夫家的餅舖珍賀齋即將面臨關門的命運，婆婆要北上依靠三子一女度過晚年。小鷗假裝事不關己，卻陸續聽到幾個兒女像詐騙集團一樣訛詐婆婆的養老金，激起她的同情心，想幫婆婆一把。落到無家可歸的彩香急需幫助，但援手來自於這不得她疼的媳婦，她又拉不下臉。經由烘焙師發貴的巧妙牽引，小鷗跟彩香約定不以婆媳關係，而以事業

programme.title: 公視早安新聞第299集
programme.desc: 《公視早安新聞》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共電視文化事業基金會新聞部製播的晨間新聞節目，於2016年6月6日開播。本節目開播時，為國英雙語節目，其中前半小時以國語播報、後半小時為以英語播報的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公視早安新聞改為全程國語播報，而英語新聞改為週一至週五播出的《公視英語新聞》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 行走TIT第269集

programme.title: 公視越南語新聞第215集

programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 頌泉心靈醫治特會第16集

programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 【客家尋味劇場】台北歌手第3集
programme.desc: 男高音、小說家和劇作家於一身，戰後，甚至提起武器參與反抗行動，36歲的呂赫若正值大展風華才氣之際，卻不幸死於非命，作為台灣文學史上的風雲人物，客家電視台將重新打造呂赫若的生平與其作品改編為連續劇，嘗試探索才子傳奇的一生。

programme.title: 客家新聞雜誌第1021集
programme.desc: 由陳美禎主持，以客家人的觀點，結合時事和近期舉辦的各種客家活動，做詳盡而深入的各種專題探討和介紹。

programme.title: 福氣來了第75集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 後生大聲公第83集
programme.desc: 節目邀請18~25歲的客家年輕人，聊聊對客家、對教育、對媒體、對社會議題的看法。

programme.title: 日頭下‧月光光第101集
programme.desc: 此齣為與生活資訊結合的客家戲劇，客語口說藝術的劇場，其中包含了相聲竹板快書、以及說文解字，用活潑逗趣的表演方式，來傳達客家語言，敬請觀眾鎖定收看！

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第299集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面了解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第252集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 地球隊好麻吉第1集
programme.desc: 你知道大自然有多少神奇的模樣嗎？帶你一起出發找答案！每一集，我們會到四個不同國家，和世界各地的小朋友一起發現風、花、大樹、河流的秘密，讓你成為最懂地球的好麻吉，守護我們住的美麗星球！

programme.title: 恐龍大牧場 III第1集
programme.desc: 在這片自然優美、作物豐富的大西部土地上，卡西迪家族與恐龍夥伴們共同經營著牧場，過著既忙碌又充滿驚喜的生活。無論是訓練恐龍、追查野生迅猛龍的足跡，還是保護珍貴的月光百合花，孩子們與恐龍總能在挑戰中成長，在合作中找到解答。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1181集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 客家新聞雜誌第1021集
programme.desc: 由陳美禎主持，以客家人的觀點，結合時事和近期舉辦的各種客家活動，做詳盡而深入的各種專題探討和介紹。

programme.title: 福氣來了第75集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 一家之煮第474集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第1集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(海陸腔)第19集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(海陸腔)第195集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個關於四位好朋友的故事，他們相聚在一起時，總是充滿著對話、爭吵和歡笑。

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第19集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理為起點，透過食材的生產關係、食物的料理過程乃至廚師的烹飪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》試著以人與料理的故事，建立與客家概念的連結與對照，勾勒客家飲食多元豐富的面向。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第307集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 飛越客庄第22集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第15集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的了解。

programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1633集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: 恐龍大牧場 III第2集
programme.desc: 在這片自然優美、作物豐富的大西部土地上，卡西迪家族與恐龍夥伴們共同經營著牧場，過著既忙碌又充滿驚喜的生活。無論是訓練恐龍、追查野生迅猛龍的足跡，還是保護珍貴的月光百合花，孩子們與恐龍總能在挑戰中成長，在合作中找到解答。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1182集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 村民大會-過家尞聊正事第116集
programme.desc: 打造一台行動雜貨店，駛入客庄大街小巷，歡迎鄉親一起來喝茶聊天，暢談地方議題，大人小孩都來「過家尞聊正事」，關心客庄大小事！

programme.title: 福氣來了第76集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等項目。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 一家之煮第475集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾了解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第2集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(大埔腔)第19集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(大埔腔)第195集
programme.desc: 朋友聚在一起時，總是會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，以及許多有趣的故事。這個節目「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」，描述的就是四個好朋友間的種種經歷和冒險故事。

programme.title: 懂吃懂吃來煮食第6集
programme.desc: 踏上歡愉的旅程，烹煮出暖心的滋味！

programme.title: 當晝新聞第308集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 飛越客庄第23集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客庄的人文風情和自然景觀。這套設備擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客庄所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 【客家尋味劇場】台北歌手第4集
programme.desc: 男高音、小說家和劇作家於一身，戰後，甚至提起武器參與反抗行動，36歲的呂赫若正值大展風華才氣之際，卻不幸死於非命，作為台灣文學史上的風雲人物，客家電視台將重新打造呂赫若的生平與其作品改編為連續劇，嘗試探索才子傳奇的一生。

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第115集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家庄裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第16集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所單歌第69集
programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的了解。

programme.title: 溜麵線雜貨店第36集
programme.desc: 節目場景復刻了早期客莊鄰里間最熱鬧、也最能聊天的雜貨店前空地。在這裡，沒有刻板的說教，只有銀髮長輩與主持人，像在大樹下乘涼般，自在地聊生活、聊煩惱，也聊那些平常說不出口的心事。

programme.desc: 故事從龍隊14年來主力重炮手柳澤博人開始；柳澤博人自球員生涯開始，就是場上耀眼焦點，直到近年陷入低潮挫折，博人因壓力而常在鎂光燈下流露負面情緒，又再接到球團不續約通知後，人生更是跌落低谷深淵，就當自己都泛起放棄的念頭時，一通求助電話，反而燃起博人對棒球的熱情，也更發現，真正的棒球，不是只有強力揮擊而已…

programme.title: 河中巨怪第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 主持人傑洛米韋德這次要挑戰世上最危險的捕魚點－東非大裂谷，尋找罕見的河中巨怪：尼羅河尖吻鱸。數千年來這裡的漁夫，為這非洲最大的淡水魚冒著性命安危，因為光一條魚就能養活整村人。這種魚是埋伏突襲掠食者，只要嘴巴吃得下，牠們什麼都吃。但是由於人類過度捕撈，這種巨魚變得更為稀有。主持人先來到烏干達的白尼羅河，發現尼羅河鱷魚橫行霸道，增添在這裡釣魚的危險性，加上又有暴風來襲，再再使得釣到巨魚的機會微乎其微。他於是轉往白尼羅河的源頭維多利亞湖，卻又發現這裡有產業規模的商業捕魚，只好北上到衣索匹亞釣魚，可惜未果，繼續往南到查莫湖，仍空手而歸。最後他來到莫契遜瀑布，究竟韋德能否如願以償，釣到傳說中的巨魚呢？

programme.desc: 主持人傑洛米韋德聽說，南非布里德河有人捕到有史以來最大的牛鯊，他接受科學考察隊的邀請，一同調查這起離奇事件。考察隊為了解開謎團，有請韋德幫忙釣鯊魚，算是韋德面臨過最大的釣魚挑戰。他發現布里德河的鯊魚有十分特定的進食方式，於是他得改變誘餌的呈現方式，好讓鯊魚感興趣。如果釣到鯊魚，科學家做完檢查就會野放，這使得當地居民一點也不高興，紛紛表示抗議。更奇怪的是，這裡的牛鯊從未攻擊人類，於是主持人向當地漁夫打聽線索。有人說也許鯊魚不喜歡人血的味道，有人覺得河裡食物太多，所以牠們才對人類不感興趣。主持人後來更發現布里德河裡的牛鯊會跟蹤漁船，等魚上鉤就一口咬走。究竟韋德能不能成功釣到牛鯊呢？請看本集的節目。

programme.title: 到美國結婚去-最後一搏第3季:第9集
programme.desc: 夏卡娜與薩波與其他幾對情侶展開全面交火。

programme.title: 好屋重生記第3季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，主持人母女檔凱倫和米娜和朋友喬許合作，翻修位於噴泉廣場橄欖街上的房子。翻修前的屋子狀況連連，甚至有活生生的蛇出沒屋內，但幾經波折後，終於將原本破舊又藏蛇的老屋翻修成漂亮的農村風格別墅，雖然節目尾聲屋子仍掛牌待售，但相信識貨買主很快就會出現。

programme.title: 戰痘醫師-突破危肌第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 李醫師準備將診所帶到全新高度，為主要診間進行現代化擴建，新增完整病房區，延攬更多醫護人員與醫師加入團隊。此外，李醫師也自拍影像，首度分享工作外的生活。

programme.title: 最奇特的人第1季:第5集

programme.title: 風城改造專家第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 艾莉森本集的客戶為年輕夫妻史蒂夫和莎拉，他們在艾凡斯頓買下一塊土地，希望自建房屋，然而原本的格局和外觀卻很不適合他們。於是艾莉森與亞里合作，為他們量身打造黃銅前門、廚房中島、長椅、與壁爐搭配的固定櫥櫃，融合新舊風格，打造出獨一無二的夢幻住家。

programme.desc: 本集節目中，亞曼達是一名網紅，專程來買藍迪菲諾利的婚紗，目標是要找到會爆紅的婚紗款式。金德拉是一名美妝類編輯，在時尚圈工作的她，對自己的婚紗要求非常高，雖然要夠特別，卻也得符合媽媽的期望。第二次來試裝的凱西再5週就要結婚，她的腰帶卻在最後關頭不見了，氣氛瞬間變得很緊張。

programme.title: 亞洲好住家第2季:第10集
programme.desc: 凱莉和小郭的人生總是交錯卻沒有好好把握機會，但是這對紐約皇后區伴侶終究還是註定在一起。

programme.title: 全美夢幻婚紗第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 藍迪認為洛艾莉絲不僅是代表紐約州的最佳新娘人選，她甚至可以代表全美。小時候就跟著媽媽移民美國的她因為媽媽後來生重病，童年時不得不與弟弟往返於數個寄養家庭，後來她成為護士在自己長大的社區服務。當初要找黑色婚紗的崔西今天來試婚紗，沒想到卻認為自己預定的婚紗顏色不夠白？

programme.title: 小鎮翻修趣第6季:第10集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，主持人接下洛特家具行的委託，將閒置已久的倉庫空間改為一間精品旅店。艾琳打算以新月線鐵路為主題，賦予每個房間獨特的風格。

programme.title: 風城改造專家第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 在本集節目中，艾莉森要幫好友泰德改造擁有絕美湖景的市區老公寓，同時也著手進行屬於自己的希臘葡萄酒。

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗第19季:第7集
programme.desc: 本集節目中，珍妮是一名鄉村音樂歌手，從小一直都覺得相貌不如姊姊的她，如今終於活出自己的天地。第二組新娘中，克羅伊曾以男兒身結過婚，如今成為跨性別後的她終於能穿上婚紗，擁有夢寐以求的婚禮與人生。第三位新娘從小常因體重被霸凌，現在的她也找到了自信心。三組新娘本來都覺得自己是醜小鴨，現在終於學會做自己了。

programme.title: 低預算造街區-紐奧良第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 艾凡和凱斯繼續雙拼屋的翻修工作，打造出租屋這一側。

programme.title: 戰痘醫師-突破危肌第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 李醫師準備將診所帶到全新高度，為主要診間進行現代化擴建，新增完整病房區，延攬更多醫護人員與醫師加入團隊。此外，李醫師也自拍影像，首度分享工作外的生活。

programme.title: 貝琳大聲說第3季:第11集
programme.desc: 貝琳面對在麥特比奇期間停藥所帶來的後續影響，並終於與醫師會面，確認自己是否罹患子宮內膜異位症。

programme.title: 湖濱淘寶翻修篇第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 安琪拉與莉莎既是同事也是好友，她們的女兒艾莉與丹妮拉也成為好友，她們希望能找間湖濱度假屋，讓人數越來越多的兩家人能一起享受箭頭湖生活，由莉莎負責幫忙找房子。她們在山丘屋、深藍屋和舒適小屋間選擇了深藍屋，並且由安琪拉負責設計，為兩家世代打造度假屋。同時也希望能出租度假屋，補貼翻修費用。

programme.title: 風城改造專家第4季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾莉森重新接手一個當初因為遲遲拿不到施工許可而放棄的舊案。

programme.title: 廚神當道亞洲版第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 亞洲頂尖家庭廚師齊聚一堂，在高壓挑戰中展現精湛廚藝，《廚神當道亞洲版》見證參賽者融合傳統與創新來打動評審。

programme.title: 大廚荷西全家遊西班牙第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 大廚荷西帶三位女兒回到他的家鄉阿斯土利亞，認識這一片成就他的土地。

programme.title: 失敗的減重手術第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集的患者接受胃束帶手術後，結果不如預期，還每吃必吐，只得把所有食物打成泥。另一位做了胃繞道手術，但全身贅皮累累，苦不堪言。

programme.title: 小鎮好住家第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 戴薇娜樂於幫助人們尋找理想家園，而這次的案子對她來說別具意義，因為戴薇娜的媽媽決定從佛州搬來哈德遜河谷。

programme.title: 戰痘醫師第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 戰痘醫師桑德拉李這次開刀得特別小心，除了兩位病患兩上長了東西，更有人彷彿在鼠蹊處長出第三顆睪丸。翠西在20多年來都在忍受布滿整臉的硬塊，它們從鼻翼途經臉部中央，一路長到額頭和下巴，令她在公共場合極度自卑。瑞凡的右腿接近鼠蹊處掛了個大腫塊，只靠皮膚相連，外觀就像陰囊，舉凡生活中的各種活動，從上廁所到去公園運動，全都大受影響。大衛則是在鼻尖冒出了龐大的增生組織，阻礙到鼻孔、也讓他在面對人群時很不自在。李醫師準備動刀時，卻在他臉上發現了更嚴重的問題。

programme.title: 動物百分百第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 有袋類是奇異的動物，牠們和動物界其他動物最大的不同是牠們誕生的方式。

programme.title: 管教惡貓第8季:第4集
programme.desc: 克里斯和史黛芬妮這對夫婦一共養了三隻貓，他們最先養的是隻母貓叫莎夏，接著又買了公貓柯納，為了給這兩隻貓找玩伴，他們又去收容所領養了公貓傑克森，傑克森很喜歡親近人，非常討喜可愛，但是沒想到牠對其他貓咪卻跋扈囂張，所以自從傑克森進門之後，家裡就不得安寧，天天上演鬥毆火拼的戲碼，三隻貓咪非但不能共處一室甚至還水火不容，傑克森經常逞凶鬥狠，有一次把柯納的尾巴咬斷，也把莎夏咬傷，夫婦倆好幾度將愛貓緊急送醫，獸醫也勸他們送走傑克森圖個清淨，但因為史黛芬妮捨不得人前乖巧的傑克森，所以他們就去請教動物行為專家，他們也聽從建議把傑克森再重新鄭重介紹給另外兩隻貓認識，但是家裡的火藥味並未稍減，貓咪之間依然彼此劍拔

programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些小動物卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是馬達加斯加的番茄蛙。番茄蛙的外型非常搶眼，身體呈現濃郁的血紅色，牠是一種突襲掠食者，除了是挖洞高手以外，身上還會分泌劇毒黏液，更可怕的是，牠受到刺激時還會膨脹成巨大的肌肉怪物。

programme.title: 動物百分百第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 貓科動物大約有38種，每一種都有自己的特色，牠們住在各式各樣的棲息地，有山中幽靈，荒地的潛行者。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 傑夫醫生以收費低廉的佛心而聞名，因為他認為即使是低收入的民眾，也應該享有負擔得起的寵物醫療服務。這天一位飼主淚眼汪汪地帶著她的愛犬前來求助，因為牠被馬踢中頭頂，頭部出現凹陷且大量流血。這是相當罕見的病例，即使對經驗老到的傑夫醫生也是。但傑夫醫生仍成功將傷狗顱竇內的骨頭碎片一一取出，完成手術，救回牠的命。一隻備受疼愛的幼犬腿部骨折，讓佩特拉醫生面臨挑戰，因為如果打錯骨釘可不能重來。同時傑夫醫生為野貓為患的社區解決問題，捕捉大量的野貓帶回診所做結紮手術。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些小動物卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是新墨西哥的北美巨蜈蚣。北美巨蜈蚣在短短幾秒內就可以殺死昆蟲和小型哺乳動物，因為牠們的身體前方擁有一對力大無窮的毒爪，而且牠們的抓力也非常驚人，可以牢牢抓住所有表面，從任何方向發動攻擊，因此獵物一旦落入牠們的掌心，根本沒有活命的機會。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些小動物卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是南非的犰狳蜥。犰狳蜥的外觀看起來彷彿是神話裡的銜尾蛇，牠有咬力超強的雙顎，一口就可以把獵物咬到粉身碎骨，此外，牠身上的鋸齒狀鱗片硬度甚至可媲美金屬，全身蜷縮起來的時候宛如一座堅不可摧的堡壘。

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:第1集

programme.title: 管教惡貓第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 洛杉磯的動物收容所貓滿為患，而且每況愈下。當民間的收容所容量已達飽和時，許多幼貓就被送到市立收容所。由於幼貓需要大量的心力照顧，市立收容所沒有人力支援，因此假如幼貓沒有人認養就會被安樂死。然而洛杉磯根本沒有足夠的家庭可認養或收養這些貓咪，結果造大量無辜的幼貓面臨死亡命運。好友動物協會發起洛杉磯不殺生運動，從市立收容所拯救出50隻幼貓，將牠們送到收養家庭照顧到健康的八周，並完成疫苗注射和絕育手術。現在好友動物協會請求傑克森的協助，希望他有人脈能幫助這50隻幼貓找到認養的人家。

programme.title: 飛天小女警第136集
programme.desc: 小鎮村本來是一個平凡的小鎮，可是自從遺傳學家尤教授來到鎮上以後，這個平凡的小鎮就搖身一變成為一個的舉世矚目的地方，尤教授希望可以運用科學方法，創造出世界上最完美的小女孩，他將蜜糖和香料等各種甜美的材料混在一起，不過他不小心將神秘的化學原素X也給加了進去，結果就創造出三個模樣可愛，嫉惡如仇、誓與罪犯周旋到底的飛天小女警。

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第16集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶、太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶。 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型、甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星。兔寶寶、太菲鴨、傻大鳥、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼。 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界。

programme.title: 見見超級蝙蝠車第1011集
programme.desc: 他們是一群打擊犯罪、擁有知覺的超能車輛，跟著蝙蝠俠、羅賓、蝙蝠女還有許多DC超級英雄一起捍衛高譚市。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第5集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。

programme.title: 怪盜喬克第4集
